method_zh: 逐项比较中英文的核心判断、数字、单位、证据边界、图题、图例和文件位置。机器只核对文件存在与配对关系，等义结论由作者按清单逐项签注。
method_en: Compare each Chinese-English pair for the main judgement, numbers, units, evidence boundary, titles, legends, and file location. Machines check file presence and pairing only; the author signs the semantic judgement item by item.
